# ARKhives 8.19.6

- Reviewer List view uses aligned columns for the subject, study actions, and mastery. Narrower windows stack the subject above the study controls.
- Reviewer Grid view has consistent heading space and shorter cards that allow rows of subjects to align.
- Reviewer detail pages show only the available study modes. Flashcard-only reviewers open their details and offer flashcard study.
- Analytics tabs stay below the actual header on narrower desktop windows. Switching workspaces opens the next page at the top.
- Study Planner and Study Library use the workspace spacing and panel styles.
- The desktop question map aligns with the study panels, and the latest guidance button is clear of ArkBot.
